topology: 1 node x4 H100, NVSHMEM chain: PE i -> i+1 only, volume growing along the chain
workload_note: `asym_patterns pipe 4096 3`. PE i sends slot*(i+1)/npes elems to PE i+1 and nothing to anyone else; PE 3 sends nothing at all. So the rank-space matrix is a single superdiagonal — 1024, 2048, 3072 elems/iter — with a structurally empty last row and, crucially, zero back-flow. This is the case that can tell 'we record direction' apart from 'we symmetrise and nobody noticed', which no ring or pair capture in the corpus can.
